identity.kind: LPG gas cylinder (cylinder size not readable)

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a clearly readable capacity marking/label (20kg) or any clear proof of 'tokunbo' status.

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 20kg (label/plate not readable).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity marking (e.g., '20kg') or the cylinder data plate/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-size used LPG cylinder (worst case for buyer: not confirmed 20kg).

risks.risk: Cylinder condition may be unsafe (rust, dents, valve wear) and may fail inspection/leak test.
risks.proof: Video/close-ups of the valve area and the full cylinder body (including bottom ring), plus a leak-test result or proof of recent inspection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used cylinder with unknown safety/condition (worst case: treat as needing inspection/leak test).

risks.risk: Valve/regulator compatibility and completeness may be missing or not included.
risks.proof: Photo of the full valve/regulator assembly showing all parts, and whether regulator/hose is included (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as cylinder only (worst case: no usable regulator/hose included).

risks.risk: Possible scam/false listing (tokunbo claim not verifiable from photo).
risks.proof: Ask for receipt/transfer proof or a photo of the cylinder with a current date and the seller’s ID/handwritten note.
risks.if_unproven: Price conservatively as a standard used cylinder without relying on 'tokunbo' claim.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity marking (confirm 20kg).
Close-up of the valve/regulator area (clear view of all markings and condition).
Full clear photos of the entire cylinder body and bottom ring (showing dents/cracks/rust severity).
Proof of leak test/inspection (receipt or a simple test result).
Confirm what exactly is included: cylinder only vs cylinder + regulator + hose.
response.reason: The photo shows an LPG cylinder, but the key pricing driver (confirmed 20kg capacity) and safety/condition proof are not readable. Without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
